title: Orange Warrior Child
description: A young Black girl with orange dreadlocks stands in a dynamic combat pose against a dark gray studio backdrop. She wears a detailed post-apocalyptic warrior outfit in shades of orange with black stripes, including a cropped vest with skull and bone decorations, ripped pants, a utility belt with pouches and chains, striped arm wraps, and heavy boots.
prompt: A young Black girl with vibrant orange dreadlocks styled wildly, wearing an intricate post-apocalyptic warrior costume in bright orange and black. The outfit includes a cropped leather vest with skull and bone patches, ripped orange pants, a wide utility belt with hanging chains and bells, striped orange and black arm wraps and leg wraps, and heavy black boots. She is in a strong action pose with one fist pulled back and the other extended, looking directly at the viewer with a confident expression, dramatic studio lighting against a solid dark gray background.
